text: Reorder the words to make a correct question: (had / long have / earrings / you / How / those / ?)
options: How long have you had those earrings?
How long you have had those earrings?
How long have had you those earrings?
How long you had those earrings have?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال عن المدة الزمنية في المضارع التام: How long + have/has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث.
explanation.B: خطأ: الفاعل 'you' يجب أن يأتي بعد 'have' مباشرة في السؤال.
explanation.C: خطأ: 'had' هو التصريف الثالث ويجب أن يبقى بعد الفاعل.

text: Reorder the words to make a correct question: (plastic / Have / used / to make / costumes / you / ?)
options: You have used plastic to make costumes?
Have you used plastic to make costumes?
Have you plastic used to make costumes?
Have used you plastic to make costumes?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال: Have + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول + باقي الجملة.
explanation.B: خطأ: المفعول 'plastic' يجب أن يأتي بعد الفعل 'used'.
explanation.D: خطأ في ترتيب الفاعل والفعل المساعد.

text: Reorder the words to make a correct question: (has / silver / How long / bracelet / Lailah / that / worn / ?)
options: How long has Lailah worn that silver bracelet?
How long has worn Lailah that silver bracelet?
How long Lailah has worn that silver bracelet?
How long has that silver bracelet Lailah worn?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال عن المدة مع فاعل مفرد: How long + has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول.
explanation.B: خطأ: 'has' يجب أن تسبق الفاعل في السؤال.
explanation.C: خطأ: الفعل 'worn' يجب أن يبقى بعد الفاعل 'Lailah'.

text: Reorder the words to make a correct question: (hair / his / Has / brushed / new brush / Arshad / with the / ?)
options: Has Arshad his hair brushed with the new brush?
Arshad has brushed his hair with the new brush?
Has Arshad brushed his hair with the new brush?
Has brushed Arshad his hair with the new brush?

explanation.A: صحيح! السؤال: Has + فاعل + تصريف ثالث + مفعول + أداة.
explanation.B: خطأ: 'brushed' يجب أن يأتي قبل المفعول 'his hair'.
explanation.C: خطأ: الفاعل يجب أن يأتي قبل الفعل الرئيسي 'brushed'.

text: Write the sentence using 'be made of': (This / ring / gold)
options: This ring is made of gold.
This ring is made from gold.
This ring is make of gold.

explanation.A: صحيح! نستخدم 'is made of' عندما تبقى المادة الخام واضحة في المنتج النهائي.
explanation.B: 'Made from' تستخدم عندما تتغير المادة كيميائياً أثناء التصنيع (مثل الورق من الخشب).

text: Write the sentence using 'be made of': (My / earrings / plastic)
options: My earrings are make of plastic.
My earrings are made of plastic.
My earrings is made of plastic.

explanation.A: صحيح! الفاعل جمع 'earrings' يأخذ الفعل المساعد 'are'.

text: Write the sentence in negative form: (The / costumes / not / silk)
options: The costumes aren't make of silk.
The costumes not made of silk.
The costumes isn't made of silk.
The costumes aren't made of silk.

explanation.A: صحيح! النفي في المضارع البسيط مع جمع: are not = aren't + made of.

text: Write the sentence in negative form: (Badria's / umbrella / not / wool)
options: Badria's umbrella aren't made of wool.
Badria's umbrella isn't made of wool.
Badria's umbrella not made of wool.
Badria's umbrella doesn't made of wool.

explanation.A: صحيح! الفاعل 'umbrella' مفرد يأخذ 'isn't'.
explanation.D: خطأ: 'doesn't' لا تستخدم مع الصيغة المبنية للمجهول هنا.

text: Write the sentence using 'be made of': (This / tie / wood) - yes, it's a special wooden tie!
options: This tie is made of wood.
This tie is made from wood.
This tie are made of wood.

explanation.A: صحيح! رغم أنها غير مألوفة، لكن الجملة صحيحة نحوياً.
explanation.B: 'Made from' ممكنة أيضاً، لكن 'made of' شائعة أكثر في هذا السياق.

text: Complete the text with the correct word (1): 'Have you been to the new arts and crafts market? Oh, you (1) __________? There are many designers there.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'haven't' هنا اختصار لـ 'have not' وتستخدم كسؤال تأكيدي: 'Oh, you haven't?' (أوه، لم تذهب؟).
explanation.B: Have وحدها لا تكفي، تحتاج إلى 'not' للنفي.
explanation.C: Didn't تستخدم مع الماضي البسيط، وليس المضارع التام.

text: Complete the text (2): 'Designers make (2) __________ things from many different materials.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'beautiful' صفة تصف الاسم 'things'.

text: Complete the text (3): 'They use many different (3) __________ like wood, metal, and silk.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'materials' هي الخامات أو المواد الأولية المستخدمة في الصنع.

text: Complete the text (4): 'There are lots of jewelry (4) __________ too!'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'accessories' تعني الإكسسوارات أو الملحقات (تشمل المجوهرات).
explanation.B: Jewelries جمع 'jewelry' لكنها غير شائعة، والصحيح 'jewelry' للمفرد والجمع.

text: Complete the text (5): 'I saw earrings (5) __________ silk and wool. They were very unique!'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'made of' لوصف المادة الخام التي لا تتغير كثيراً.
explanation.B: Made from تستخدم إذا تغيرت المادة.

text: Complete the text (6): 'One designer makes bracelets from (6) __________ plastic, which is good for the environment.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'recycled' يعني معاد تدويره، مما يساعد البيئة.
explanation.B: Plastic بلاستيك فقط، لا توحي بإعادة التدوير.
explanation.C: Old قديم لكن ليس بالضرورة معاد تدويره.

text: Complete the text (7): "I asked the designer: '(7) __________ have you been a designer?'"

explanation.A: صحيح! 'How long' للسؤال عن المدة الزمنية.
explanation.B: When للسؤال عن وقت محدد في الماضي.

text: Complete the text (8): 'I wanted to buy a (8) __________ belt with lines, but I didn't have enough money.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'striped' تعني مقلم بخطوط.

text: Complete the text (9): 'I will try to (9) __________ my own belt and ring at home.'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'make' هو الفعل العام للصنع.

text: Complete the text (10): 'Have you ever tried to make your own (10) __________?'

explanation.A: صحيح! 'designs' تعني تصاميم (أشياء من تصميمك الخاص).
explanation.B: Accessories إكسسوارات (صحيح أيضاً لكن السياق يتحدث عن التصميم).

text: This necklace __________ gold. It's very expensive.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'is made of' المادة ظاهرة.

text: Her dress is __________ silk and feels very smooth.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'made of' للحرير.

text: My favourite shirt has a __________ pattern with vertical lines.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'striped' مقلم.

text: This scarf is __________. It keeps me very warm.

explanation.A: صحيح! الصوف دافئ.

text: How long __________ you __________ that bracelet?

explanation.A: صحيح! مضارع تام للسؤال عن المدة.

text: __________ Arshad brushed his hair with the new brush?

explanation.A: صحيح! 'Has' مع المفرد.

text: She made all the __________ for the school play herself.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'costumes' أزياء المسرحية.

text: This bag is made of __________ leather. It's very strong.

explanation.A: صحيح! جلد طبيعي.

text: He wore a __________ suit to the party. Everyone noticed him.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'checked' مربعات.

text: They have __________ many accessories from recycled plastic.

explanation.A: صحيح! 'have made' مضارع تام.
